title: Modified Bacterial Conjugation Protocol For Pseudo-nitzschia multiseries
author: April Woods
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gj6bure

steps.title: Prepare Host Strain Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate G418+Kan plates with the appropriate host strain and grow overnight (use within 7 days).

substeps.instruction: Pick isolated colonies and inoculate into 10 mL LB medium.
Grow overnight at 37 °C, 200 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Concentrate the bacterial cells and resuspend in SOC medium.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm, 10 °C, for 10 min.
Decant supernatant and resuspend bacterial cell pellet in 100 μL SOC.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Subculture
steps.instruction: Grow a subculture of the host strain to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Measure OD600 and start a 150 mL LB subculture (recommended starting OD600 of 0.05 or 0.1).
Grow at 37 °C, 200 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.3-0.4.

steps.title: Harvest Pseudo-nitzschia Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate P. multiseries cells from their growth medium.

substeps.instruction: Spin down 50 mL of culture at 4000 rpm, 10 °C, for 20 min in 50 mL falcon tubes.
Remove supernatant with vacuum pipette.
Add an additional 50 mL of culture and repeat centrifugation to obtain a total of 100 mL culture pellet.
Re-suspend cell pellet in 1 mL of seawater enrichment media.
Allow suspension to come to room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Conjugation Mix
steps.instruction: Mix the diatom and bacterial cells for conjugation.

substeps.instruction: Mix 450 µL Pseudo-nitzschia cells and 50 µL E. coli cells in a 1.5 mL tube.
Mix fully by gentle pipetting.
Incubate mixture at 30 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate Conjugation Mixture
steps.instruction: Spread the mixture onto specialized agar plates and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Pre-warm 1% agar plates containing 5% (v/v) LB and 50% (v/v) filter sterilized seawater (L1 media) at 37 °C for one hour.
Gently spread the mixture on the pre-warmed plates.
Incubate in the dark at 30 °C for 90 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Conjugation Recovery
steps.instruction: Move plates to growth conditions to allow recovery.

substeps.instruction: Move plates to 15 °C and constant light for 4 hours.

steps.title: Recover Cells from Plates
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells from the agar surface.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL reduced Nitrogen L1 medium (Nitrogen:Silica ratio of 1:3).
Gently scrape agar surface with a cell scraper or L spreader to resuspend bacterial and diatom cells (expect ~500 µL recovery).

steps.title: Embed Cells in LGTA
steps.instruction: Mix the recovered cell suspension with Low Gel Temperature Agarose (LGTA).

substeps.instruction: Prepare LGTA and maintain or cool to 20 °C.
Aliquot 4 mL of molten LGTA (20 °C) into sterile culture tubes (e.g. Falcon 2059).
Add the recovered cell suspension (ca. 500 µL) into the LGTA (which contains the same 1:3 NO3:Si ratio).
Gently vortex to mix.

steps.title: Transfer to Culture Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the LGTA mixture to a multi-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL to the well of a Costar 12-well culture plate, avoiding bubbles; repeat for 4 wells.
For selection experiments, volume may be reduced to 500 µL per well and selection-free matched control wells included.
Incubate at 15 °C to allow LGTA to solidify.

steps.title: Screen and Isolate
steps.instruction: Analyze the cultures for viability and plasmid presence.

substeps.instruction: Observe plates under fluorescence microscopy for viability, growth (chlorophyll fluorescence), and eGFP expression.
Collect cells that emerge from the agarose into the liquid overlay for isolate pics.
Remove gel plugs and resuspend into liquid growth if necessary.
Screen isolate cultures for plasmid presence by PCR.
Perform DNA extraction of isolate cultures to transform E. coli and select for Kanamycin resistance.
